sampling: One fixed uniform-with-replacement schedule of 300 indices from common TRAIN ranking-eligible queries; publish eligible keys and schedule SHA. No DEV in training.
training_eligibility: At least one certified pure positive and one certified negative in unchanged Top8, with at least one strictly past history. UNKNOWN candidates masked only in supervised loss; aliases are multi-positive. All 1300 source queries retained in counts/evaluation.
prediction_target: Stop-gradient frozen current query feature, only for strictly earlier opposite-camera sources of pure positive TRAIN tracks. No labels/future frame are actor inputs.
scoring: native track probability-sum scores + 2*cosine(query, average normalized projected strictly past history). Empty-history candidates receive zero correction. C0=native, C1=identical zero-residual historical cosine.
metric_denominators: Top1/MRR on known-query positive-covered records using all legal Top8 including UNKNOWN; unverified predictions separately counted UNKNOWN, never certified errors. Paired fixes/harms require both pure known outcomes. Report all-query coverage and query/person/scene counts.
native_certification: Cached labels certify primary-before-memory baseline state only, never counterfactual full native commits. Actual native correction/harm for new heads stays null without online solver/state replay.
